facts.fact: Dimension Data Limited, a Nigerian technology infrastructure provider, raised N4.05 billion in its Series 1 bond, the first tranche of a N20 billion programme for fibre expansion, with Pathway Advisors Limited as lead issuing house and bookrunner and SEC clearance; investors are not named (published 2026-07-29, close date in July 2026).

note: Global Dimension Data brand paragraph ignored as a different company.
